data_source: Large academic medical centre (constructed from public NCSC/HSE/ENISA benchmarks)

answers.evidence: NIS2 Compliance Officer appointed and board-ratified (Group CISO, ref GOV-NIS2-2025-01); pre-registration pack prepared for NCSC portal.
Board Risk & Cyber Committee charter BRC-CHTR-2025; cyber a standing board agenda item; measures approved in BM-2026-Q1.
Cyber programme funded on a rolling annual capital cycle (FIN-CAP-2026); 18-month forward commitment not yet formally minuted.
Mandatory board cyber-governance training completed 2026-01 (LMS-BOARD-2026-01, 100% completion).
ISO/IEC 27001-aligned ISMS policy suite ISMS-POL v4.1, certified scope covers core clinical systems; owner Group CISO.
Policy coverage matrix POL-MAP-2026 maps every Art.21(2) area and all 16 NCSC RMMs to an owned policy.
Annual enterprise risk assessment RA-2026-ACAD (ISO 27005), refreshed quarterly for high-risk research systems.
Critical Asset Register CAR-2026 v3.0; EHR, PACS, LIS, ePMA, research HPC classified; owner IT Asset Manager.
Independent internal audit IA-CYBER-2026-02 and annual third-party penetration test PEN-2026-01 on record.
Post-incident review standard PROC-IR-004 v2.0; lessons-learned feed control updates (PIR register 2025-2026).
Risk-based patch SLA policy ITS-STD-007 v2.1 (critical 72h, high 14d); Tenable + WSUS/Intune compliance >95%.
Quarterly backup restore tests BKP-RESTORE-2026-Q1/Q2; immutable backups; owner Infrastructure Lead.
Security awareness mandatory; completion 88% (LMS-RPT-2026-05); rolling enforcement for remaining clinical staff.
CMDB (ServiceNow) strong for IT; networked medical devices/OT only ~70% inventoried (MDS-GAP-2026-01).
Garda vetting and pre-employment screening register HR-VET-2026 for clinical/privileged roles.
Automated joiner-mover-leaver via IGA (SailPoint); leaver deprovisioning SLA <2h; sample SNOW-LVR-2026.
Enterprise MFA (Entra ID + FIDO2) enforced for all remote and privileged access; coverage report IAM-RPT-2026-06 = 100%.
PAM (CyberArk) for privileged accounts; least-privilege RBAC recertified quarterly PAR-2026-Q1.
Tier III data centres, badge + biometric access, environmental monitoring; audit FAC-ENV-2026.
Encryption at rest (TDE + full-disk) across clinical databases and endpoints; KMS-managed keys CRY-STD-005 v2.
TLS 1.2/1.3 enforced (grade A, SSLSCAN-2026-05); mTLS for sensitive integrations.
Security schedules + right-to-audit in top-50 supplier contracts; standard NIS2 clause library LEG-CYB-2026.
Top clinical vendors risk-assessed (TPRM-2026); academic research collaborators and grant-funded SaaS only partially covered.
Secure-by-design gate SDLC-CHK-009 applied to enterprise procurements; bespoke research/clinical-trial systems inconsistently gated.
Board-approved Incident Response Plan IRP-PLAN-006 v2.0; 24/7 SOC; playbooks for ransomware/EHR outage.
Two exercises in 12 months: ransomware tabletop TTX-2025-11 and live red-team RT-2026-02.
24h early-warning runbook IRP-PROC-007 v2.0; named owner, on-call rota; validated test submission TEST-EW-2026-02.
24/7 SOC with Microsoft Sentinel SIEM + MDR; EDR on all endpoints; detection coverage report SOC-2026-Q2.
BCP BCP-PLAN-010 v2.0 with RTO/RPO for Tier 1 systems validated at main campus; satellite-site continuity not fully validated.
Annual DR failover proven for primary data centre (DR-TEST-2026-03); full multi-site failover incl. medical devices not yet exercised end-to-end.
